registration_note: Add "dashboard-virtual-scroll.spec.js" to the Dashboards-Core group's run_files in .github/workflows/playwright.yml (run-context playwright_group: Dashboards-Core).
rationale: No existing spec asserts dashboard-table row windowing: bounded DOM row count, spacer rows (tr[aria-hidden=true]), or the data-index window sliding on scroll. dashboard-table-chart.spec.js only checks basic rendering/sorting; dashboard-table-pagination.spec.js and dashboard-config-table.spec.js exercise wrap/pagination controls but never assert virtual scroll is bypassed (no spacers + unbounded rows). This is a distinct area within Dashboards -> new spec.
